reviews.disposition:
Historical whole-book family queue under AD32/AD36/AD43/AD45/AD51. Preserve full-book/every-little-idea intent, all eight families, memory-owner exclusion, other-book boundary and later Round2 transfer: sw-wire takes host integration, sw-absorb retains lead data/gates, sw-slots supplies the runner and sw-gaps folds intake. Volume walk and GM/WA codes are navigation, not source-read or playable coverage. The141 intake lines and listed commits are not141 accepted decisions or working features. Folding proposals into rule/GM/QR6 owners does not establish acceptance; silence under a default-proceeds choice proposal is not human acceptance.

The overnight every-slice-unwired statement is dated, not current proof that later B/R consumers remain absent. Old model assignments, three/ten delegated-lane counts, commits,90/85/88-percent usage thresholds, Nov2 hard end,40-minute nudges and send caps establish no current worker/process/permission or new dispatch. Do not wrap current limited npm test again because of this old gate instruction. Later source/consumer owners and current Klein-first direction preserve the horizon without restarting this wave. Full queue, tables and ending were read; no family ledgers/intake/commits/chapters or live workers were inspected.

reviews.classification: historical queue / source-card attribution / research procedure / bounded scout
reviews.disposition:
Full five-stage/E1–E8/output-contract and round2–5 workflow review under AD32/AD35/AD36. Preserve authority/input/format recovery and the rule→state/perception→eligibility/choice→payment→effect→feedback→loss chain with exact captured/selected/traced/unread status. Mono/script/native routes depend on actual format; raw strings are not recovered source. A saved procedure/independent-review recommendation grants no new launch/install/delegation/runtime authority. The dated Qud/Rain World/DF ownership table is not live-process proof.

Later supplements matter: valid native references/unwind/RTTI narrow identity without proving every slot; signedness, widths/overflow, selectors, vector erase and caller order require actual instructions/IL/helpers. Empty xrefs/one-byte inferred bodies remain incomplete. True/no-op/queued/in-memory/callback/physical success differ. Checksums can warn while parsing continues; backend write catches can leave an outer completion path. Core/campaign writes, process latches and durable disk/cloud state are separate.

Actor body retention, ID links, reference tables, transient queues, scheduler/physical admission and actual recovery selectors differ. Missing queue serialization alone cannot prove actor loss; retained detached bodies are not automatically placeable. Generic contents walks need not visit arbitrary fields. Bilateral unlink, freed output, positive produced-stack counts and vector consolidation do not prove input refund. A specific enclosing handler/caller/pointer/quantity determines compensation; a missing local catch does not exclude outer recovery. Same-process retry, pending/new process, retained backend key and last-on-disk save differ. Snapshot timing can mix nested old strings with new progression; registration/hooks/plugins prevent a main-assembly absence proving a live registry empty. E7 examines donor caps, not a universal anti-exploit requirement under AD22/AD38. Full ending was recovered after truncation. No underlying source/native artifact, process, game/save or linked report was newly inspected; no static finding authorizes dynamic reproduction by itself.

reviews.classification: historical queue / source-card attribution / research procedure / bounded scout
reviews.disposition:
Full initial-scout chronology under AD32/AD35/AD36: F1–F3, P1–P5, M1–M3, R1–R3, K1–K3, A1–A4, C1–C5/D1–D2 and V1–V2 were read. The later user-pasted ChatGPT answer/27-candidate expansion supersedes initial response-render failure for breadth; five groups are questions, not a donor cap or accepted implementation order. Later61-artifact acquisition, fully read B495, supersedes the initial no-whole-pack-download state without extending this scout's actual semantic reading. Nineteen static files/six repos/2,028,685 bytes are bounded samples, and temporary inputs need reproducible pins rather than assumed permanent existence.

Silent Gear4 changes cannot inherit an older synergy formula; Tetra replacement, Tinkers traits/modifiers and material preparation need distinct consumers. Original metal/coating/ward examples are proposals, not Minecraft facts or proof YAIR lacks all comparable behavior. Apotheosis data is not runtime roll/cost/preservation order. Vault Third Edition/Remastered and original Roguelike/inspired packs remain different. Botania localization/checkmark/manual metadata is not an executable success check; custody does not establish maker/procedure. Hex's failed guessed repo does not erase versioned docs, and typed spell choices need not require a programming language. Thaumcraft author text/Ars links do not recover their full algorithms.

Above and Beyond's reset-tag script still needs actual reward/caller/atomicity proof. Enigmatica38 chapters/817 scripts preserve expert-mode distinction, not817 delivered features. Nomifactory845 parsed records do not establish a dependency/reward graph or CEu/Monifactory equivalence. Static source, quest, script, manual, manifest and JAR roles have different evidence. License labels remain source/version observations, not broad copying/deployment clearance. C1–C5 retain useful expedition/material/part, intermediate treatment, tutorial-versus-contract, affix rework and learned-carrier alternatives; no universal anti-recursion cap or mandatory craft engine follows. P3/P4 and full workflow/scout ending were recovered after output truncation. Current review reads no linked external page, sample source, archive, game or save and dispatches nothing; formulas/reward atomicity/provenance/compatibility remain named deeper-reading questions.
